latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release — generate 1080p HD videos from text prompts or images, completely free.

- Instantly turn short text or up to three images into HD video clips (MP4 and more) via a cloud-based pipeline, ready in 1–2 minutes.
- Handles quick product promos, social content, and automated video edits from simple, natural language prompts.
- Includes free, anonymous usage with auto-generated credits and no registration required.
- Integrated cloud API: auto-setup, prompts trigger video creation, seamless export, and session management.
- Supports basic editing, audio tracks, text overlays, preview, and multiple formats (mp4, mov, jpg, png, etc.).
- Clear error handling and onboarding. Supports quick export, credit checks, uploads, and timeline previews.
